set system host-name DeviceA.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols isis instance 1 router-id.explanation: 配置ISIS协议的实例及其路由器ID。

parameters.name: router-id
parameters.explanation: 路由器的ID，用于ISIS协议中标识路由器。

set protocols isis instance 1.explanation: This command configures an IS-IS instance with the specified `[parameter1]`, enabling IS-IS routing protocol on the device.

net 49.0001.0000.0000.0001.00.explanation: Configure examples of ISIS protocols and web entity titles.

parameters.name: net
parameters.explanation: Web entity title, used to identify ISIS networks.

set protocols isis interface ge-2/0/0.0.explanation: Enables an IS-IS protocol on the specified interface.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address 10.1.1.2/24.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.
